{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor-shielded storage compartments''' were illegally modified [[Droid Storage Module]]s. The modules were fitted with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-absorbent material which made it virtually impossible to scan the interior of the modules, effectively hiding their contents from scrutiny. [[Utilitech/Legends|Utilitech's]] [[Droid Storage Module]]s were commonly modified by some [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owners.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
